arguments.message: You can verify whether there’s been an outage on our status page. The page keeps a history that goes back earlier in the day, so you can look at past windows even after the fact. If an incident is ongoing, subscribing to status‑page updates will surface it in real time. Once an incident is resolved, a written summary is posted that details what happened, the affected window, and whether any data was impacted.
